SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: COMMON
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Common helps you succeed in LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: COMMON
Study Common like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Respond appropriately to general • In pairs

What this means
In this part you learn to Respond appropriately to general • In pairs. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Respond appropriately to general • In pairs.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Common”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Respond appropriately to general • In pairs. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Respond appropriately to farewell and respond to farewell whenever with reference to time at home need arises. and at school. • Learners could be encouraged to

What this means
In this part you learn to Respond appropriately to farewell and respond to farewell whenever with reference to time at home need arises. and at school. • Learners could be encouraged to. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Respond appropriately to farewell and respond to farewell whenever with reference to time at home need arises. and at school. • Learners could be encouraged to.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Common to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Respond appropriately to farewell and respond to farewell whenever with reference to time at home need arises. and at school. • Learners could be encouraged to. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Common is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Common”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: Respond appropriately to general • In pairs)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Common to a partner. (skill: Respond appropriately to farewell and respond to farewell whenever with reference to time at home need arises. and at school. • Learners could be encouraged to)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Common to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Respond appropriately to general • In pairs.
3. Practise this skill: Respond appropriately to farewell and respond to farewell whenever with reference to time at home need arises. and at school. • Learners could be encouraged to.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Common from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Common: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Common?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Common means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Respond appropriately to general • In pairs.
5. Be able to: Respond appropriately to farewell and respond to farewell whenever with reference to time at home need arises. and at school. • Learners could be encouraged to.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
